When to drink
red bull energy drink is appreciated worldwide by top athletes, students, busy professionals and travelers on long journeys.

What's inside the can 
caffeine: caffeine was widely used by ancient civilisations. It was traditionally consumed from natural sources like tea, coffee, cacao beans and cola nuts and appreciated for its stimulating effects on the human body.
Taurine: taurine is an amino acid, naturally occurring in the human body and present in the daily diet.
Sucralose & acesulfame-potassium: sucralose and acesulfame-potassium are among the most-tested and most-used sugar substitutes worldwide. 
Water: water is a main ingredient of red bull.

items.description: At magnum, we believe that a day without pleasure is a day lost. That’s why we’ve been creating our decadent ice cream indulgences since 1989. Belgian chocolate has an outstanding reputation for its smooth, rich flavour and tempting chocolate aroma. Magnum ice cream bars are crafted in this rich heritage and are made with a signature belgian chocolate recipe developed specifically for us. Embark on a gastronomic adventure to the sun-kissed coast of Portugal with our irresistible Oven-Roasted Portuguese Parisian Potatoes! Infused with the spirit of Mediterranean flavors, this culinary masterpiece is a delightful fusion of French elegance and Portuguese charm.

Handcrafted with care, each potato is lovingly transformed into petite, marble-sized gems reminiscent of the cobbled streets of Lisbon. Roasted to golden perfection in the oven, these potatoes develop a tantalizingly crispy exterior that gives way to a soft, velvety center – a textural symphony that will leave you enchanted with every mouthful.

items.description:
Indulge in the passionate and intense flavors of our Homemade Piri Piri Hot Sauce! This artisanal creation takes the essence of the famous African chili pepper and transforms it into a tantalizing symphony of taste that will set your taste buds ablaze.

Handcrafted with love and precision, we source the finest Piri Piri peppers to ensure an authentic and robust heat that ignites the senses. Our secret blend of peppers delivers the perfect balance of spiciness and depth, capturing the true essence of this iconic chili.
items.name: Hot Sauce

items.description:
Embark on a gastronomic adventure to the sun-kissed coast of Portugal with our irresistible Oven-Roasted Portuguese Parisian Potatoes! Infused with the spirit of Mediterranean flavors, this culinary masterpiece is a delightful fusion of French elegance and Portuguese charm.

Handcrafted with care, each potato is lovingly transformed into petite, marble-sized gems reminiscent of the cobbled streets of Lisbon. Roasted to golden perfection in the oven, these potatoes develop a tantalizingly crispy exterior that gives way to a soft, velvety center – a textural symphony that will leave you enchanted with every mouthful.
items.name: Parisienne Potatoes

items.description: At magnum, we believe that a day without pleasure is a day lost. That’s why we’ve been creating our decadent ice cream indulgences since 1989. As one of our classic flavours, magnum almond ice cream bar offers a truly indulgent crunch: velvety smooth vanilla ice cream dipped in cracking magnum milk chocolate and almonds. Because almonds and magnum chocolate were just born for each other. available in both full-sized and mini bars, bite into this luxurious treat unlike any other. Explore the full range of magnum ice cream bars and discover an expansive world of pleasure. Each flavour is made with belgian chocolate that uses cocoa beans sourced from rainforest alliance certified farms. Belgian chocolate has an outstanding reputation for its smooth, rich flavour and tempting chocolate aroma. It’s recognized around the world because of its meticulous adherence to “old world” craftsmanship. Magnum ice cream bars are crafted in this rich heritage and are made with a signature belgian chocolate recipe developed specifically for us. While still warm, this delicious coating wraps around our velvety ice creams, instantly cooling to leave our signature solid, thick shell – ready and waiting to be cracked. From intense to sweet to salty to dark, which one will satisfy your next indulgence?

items.description:
Soda in a can. Or if you prefer, pop in a can.   Now if you were born in certain areas you would call this a Coke. Every type of soda pop is referred to as a Coke. So if the server asks Can I get you anything to drink" and you respond "I'll have a Coke", they will inevitably ask "What kind would you like"? and you are welcome at that point to say "Just get me a Pepsi, please? All I want's a Pepsi" Just one Pepsi but she wouldn't give it to me
 all I wanted was a Pepsi
just one Pepsi 
and she wouldn't give it to me
Just one Pepsi

Uber Eats is demanding we have descriptions for each and every item on the menu and they threatened to auto-supply AI generated descriptions.   This really just does not work for me. So order a Coke, a Pepsi, a soda, a pop- whatever you'd like to feel refreshed.
